name: Cynthia Price, Mindful Awareness in Body-oriented Therapy (MABT)
why: Research-based interoceptive training; overlaps affect/interoception.

name: Stephen Porges, Polyvagal Theory
why: Theory widely used in somatic therapy (SE, van der Kolk); contested; for foundations.

name: Andrea Olsen, Body and Earth
why: Experiential anatomy and ecology; more-than-human somatics.

name: Irene Dowd, Taking Root to Fly
why: Ideokinesis lineage after Sweigard.

name: Trager Approach (Milton Trager)
why: Somatic bodywork and Mentastics movement; check salience first.

name: Joseph La Delfa et al. — Are Drones Meditative? (CHI EA 2019)
why: Early Drone Chi study; folded into Drone Chi here, could be its own paper entry.

name: Núñez-Pacheco, Sanches et al. — Where is the Body in Designing (Through) AI? (CHI EA 2026)
why: Soma design and AI; Höök-group authors, so for hook-lab or methods.

name: Kaho Abe & Katherine Isbister — Hotaru (CHI EA 2016)
why: Wearable social movement game where players share 'energy' by touching; first author Japanese-American, check with east-asia.

name: Inner Garden (Roo, Gervais, Frey, Hachet, CHI 2017)
why: Breath- and heart-driven mixed-reality sandbox for mindfulness; better fit for intimate-care / affect.

name: Sarah Fdili Alaoui & Baptiste Caramiaux — Movement Qualities as Interaction Modality (DIS 2012)
why: Movement-quality sensing; belongs to movement-art (movement-computing).

name: LumiTouch (Chang et al., CHI EA 2001)
why: Picture frames that glow when the partner touches theirs; light rather than touch, weaker fit.

name: Hugvie / Paro / Kasahara 'Preemptive Action' / Tamaki 'PossessedHand'
why: Japanese social-touch robots and EMS agency works; for east-asia.

name: Kissenger (Samani, Cheok et al.)
why: Remote kissing robot; Cheok's lab in Singapore/Japan, check with east-asia.

name: Pat Pataranutaporn — AI and bodily futures (MIT Media Lab)
why: Thai researcher; for east-asia.

name: Yuhan Hu & Guy Hoffman — shape-changing robot skin (goosebumps)
why: Soft robot skin expressing emotion through texture; first author Chinese, for east-asia.

name: Mirjana Prpa et al. — The Pulse Breath Water System (2017)
why: Breath-driven immersive VR; left by affect-biodata to this batch, not added (no abstract or video verified yet).

name: Guy Hoffman & Michael Suguitan — Blossom (THRI 2019)
why: Handcrafted soft social robot with woolly exterior; felt-body angle is secondary.

name: Temple Grandin — Hug Machine / squeeze machine
why: Deep-pressure device designed from autistic first-person experience; for intimate-care (care / neuro-motor).

name: Paul Bach-y-Rita — Vision substitution by tactile image projection (Nature 1969)
why: Foundational sensory substitution; the body learns to 'see' through the skin; for foundations.

name: Die Gute Fabrik — Johann Sebastian Joust (2011)
why: Collective slow-movement game without screens; likely movement-art (exertion-play).

name: Marco Donnarumma — Xth Sense / Corpus Nil
why: Muscle-sound biophysical performance; for movement-art (performance).

name: Osimo, Slater et al. — Conversations between self and self as Sigmund Freud (Sci Rep 2015)
why: Body-swap self-counselling in VR; care angle.

name: Tennent et al. — The Challenge of Visual-Kinaesthetic Conflict in Virtual Reality (CHI 2020)
why: Theory companion to VR Playground; could be a method/strong-concept entry.
